programmes.d: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.
When a woman investigates a clamor on the roof of her rural house, she discovers a small UFO and little aliens emerging from it. Or so it seems.
An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.
The curator of a murderers' row in a soon-to-be-defunct wax museum persuades the owner to let him keep the figures for awhile.
A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.
Two unhappy children find a happy escape in a swimming pool.
Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.
A man named Benteen leads a colony of Americans stranded on a desert planet for 30 years.
A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.
Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.
A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil. He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy: plans that Willie doesn't support!
A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. air base in the year 1959!
Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.
A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.
When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.
Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.
An astronaut declares himself a god when his ship lands on a planet populated by people smaller than ants.
Alan Richards plans to build a dam in Africa on a tribe's ancestral land. The tribe's witch doctor puts a curse on him.
A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.
A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.
A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.
A reporter finds himself trapped in a small town where the people have extraordinary powers.
A pioneer from a wagon train in 1847 sets off to find something for his ill son and stumbles into present-day New Mexico.
Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.
